title: Recheck a delegation follow-up's worktree when its turn is dispatched, not only at admission
outcome: A delegation follow-up whose worktree is removed, or whose path is reused, between its admission and its turn's dispatch is refused at dispatch with the same reason, instead of starting a turn in a missing or foreign directory.
acceptance: Recheck a delegation follow-up's worktree when its turn is dispatched, not only at admission is done
